<subject>Streamline Tasman Ridge IT Costs with Our New Approach</subject>
<body>
Dear Darren,

Speed, adaptability, and continuous productivity define Tasman Ridge. Our agile on-site and remote 24/7 support model perfectly suits a comprehensive range of outsourcing solutions – from system maintenance, software development, and upgrades to complete IT infrastructure outsourcing, including data center management.

We can provide Tasman Ridge with our Certified Microsoft and Oracle specialists at A$25/hr to support your initiatives. We employ close to 500 professionals and boast modern development hubs. Our Perth Innovation Centre is regarded as the flagship facility in Western Australia and a major benefit for you.

https://www.tasmanridge.com.au/

Over time, our Global Technology Centres (GTCs) in Perth have built a strong track record of delivering projects for our Australian, Asian, and European clients.

Our Innovation Centres (ICs) and GTCs offer the following services to customers:

   a.. Cloud Migration
   b.. Data Analytics and IoT Solutions
   c.. Application Re-engineering Services
   d.. Legacy System Porting Services
   e.. 24x7 Help Desk and Call Centre Support

While all services can be delivered from any of our Innovation Centres, clients receive added value by leveraging our offshore Technology Delivery capabilities. Please visit https://www.tasmanridge.com.au/

This round-the-clock development and delivery framework enables Tasman Ridge to quickly scale resources to meet project demands, support concurrent workflows, and maintain a virtual 24-hour workday on client engagements.

Darren, please let us know if we can arrange a brief meeting to go over these details. Looking forward to your reply.

Regards,

Martha Soto  
martha.soto@tasmanridge.com.au
